title: COUNTROWS ( ALLNOBLANKROW ( table ) ) does not count the blank row

source.quote: ALLNOBLANKROW does not return the blank row
source.supports: ALLNOBLANKROW leaves the blank row out

source.quote: returns all rows but the blank row, or all distinct values of a column but the blank row
source.supports: all rows but the blank row

derivation: Sales rows 3 and 4 have ProductKey 9, which Product lacks, so the relationship is invalid and Product gets a blank row. ALLNOBLANKROW ( Product ) returns only the 3 stored rows.
